title: core + runtime: a residual-twin job refusal (ambiguous-in-environment) can carry one candidate; no PackageScopedHolder kind names a top-level job outside every package (ADR-0150 D3)
body:
domain:server#7 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYm8sWjp2Pk76warN7w

Child of the ADR-0150 epic #31527. This card carries S1 and N1 of the epic red-line read 6793085339 on PR #32410 (#32355).

**Where.** After #32410, a residual top-level job that shares its name with one body's job is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` `ambiguous-in-environment`. The refusal reuses #32294's `PackageScopedRefusal` shape: `candidates` of `kind: 'package'`.

**What is wrong:**
- **S1.** When no body carries the artifact's id, `candidates` holds only the declaring body. The residual is named in the message alone, so a consumer reading `candidates` sees an "ambiguous" refusal with one package. No `PackageScopedHolder` kind spells "top level, no package".
- **N1.** When the residual's owner is another body, that owner appears in `candidates` as a plain `package` holder, although its body declares no such job.

Reach today is limited to the job run's failure record. No door answers this refusal to a client.

**Do:**
1. Decide how a top-level job outside every package is named as a holder. This is either a new holder kind in `@objectstack/core`'s `PackageScopedHolder` (ADR vocabulary, so the ADR-0150 amendment card records it) or an existing kind if one fits. Read the doors' `details.candidates` consumers before choosing.
2. Make the residual-twin refusal list both holders in `candidates`, each with the right kind.
3. Pin it with the two arrangements, with and without a body carrying the artifact's id, and ablate once.

**Serial:** after #32410.
**Clause-②:** the claimer declares it. A new holder kind is a public-surface widening of `@objectstack/core`.
**Business reason:** a machine reader of the refusal cannot tell what the two holders are, so a UI or agent offering "choose a package" offers one option.

Dedupe (`PackageScopedHolder top-level kind`, `ambiguous-in-environment one candidate`, `residual job candidates`): none found.
